dict.string: Ozer uses the microphone so you can dictate survey notes in the field and record in-room meetings. Audio stays on this iPhone.
Ozer transcribes dictation and meetings on this iPhone in British English, so notes still work offline. Speech is not sent to a cloud service.
Ozer uses the camera so you can add site photos to a building survey. Photos stay on this iPhone until they upload to that survey.
Ozer lets you add existing site photos from your camera roll to a building survey library.
